title: Telegram Marketing Automation: A Small Business Guide – Repleo_blog

facts.fact: The page states that Telegram's Bot API has no approval process, no per-message charge, and no 24-hour window restriction on when a business can first message a user.
facts.quote: Telegram’s Bot API has no approval process, no per-message charge, and no 24-hour window restriction on when a business can message a user first

facts.fact: The page says creating a Telegram bot via BotFather and receiving an API token is free, instant, and requires no developer account.
facts.quote: receiving an API token — free, instant, no developer account required

facts.fact: The page describes Telegram's Business account tools (Layer 1) as free.
facts.quote: Layer 1** is Telegram’s own free Business account tools.

facts.fact: According to the page, Telegram quick replies only work in one-to-one private chats and not in group chats.
facts.quote: They only work in one-to-one private chats, not in groups

facts.fact: The page states that a Telegram greeting message fires automatically the first time someone messages the business.
facts.quote: A greeting message fires automatically the first time someone messages you.

facts.fact: The page says the Telegram /start command can carry an optional payload appended to a shared link, which lets the bot tag subscribers by entry source when they join.
facts.quote: The `/start` command also carries an optional payload — a bit of text appended to a shared link
